title: Size and place crane outrigger pads for the ground under each
instruction: Put one outrigger pad flat on each dark landing mark, centred on it, so that neither pad overloads its ground. Each outrigger presses 120 kN on its pad. The brown clay can take 100 kPa and the grey concrete 400 kPa. At full size the large pad is 1.2 m square and the small pad 0.9 m square.
context: Crane operators and riggers size outrigger pads from the outrigger load and the ground's bearing capacity; an undersized pad on soft ground lets an outrigger sink and the crane tip. Here 120 kN on clay needs 1.2 m2, so only the large pad will do there, and both pads start on the side away from where they belong.
setup: A 1:20 scene on a wooden table; positions are from the midpoint between the two arm bases, measured forward and toward the left arm. A fixed yellow crane body (70 x 80 x 50 mm) stands 330 mm forward on the midline with a short black outrigger beam on each side. Two 20 mm dark landing marks sit 330 mm forward and 130 mm to each side: the left one on a brown clay patch (120 x 110 mm), the right one on a grey concrete patch of the same size. Two orange plastic pads, 12 mm thick, lie on the table 220 mm forward: a large one (60 mm square, 80 g) 160 mm right and a small one (45 mm square, 50 g) 160 mm left.
scoring: A pad is on a mark when it lies flat on it (centre within 10 mm of the mark's centre and 4 mm of its resting height, tilted under 5 degrees). 0.25 per mark with a pad on it; plus 0.5 if both marks have pads and neither ground is overloaded, i.e. 120 kN divided by the pad's full-size area is at most the ground's capacity (only the large pad works on clay). Success once the score is 1.0 and both pads are still for 1 s.
reset_notes: Put each pad back on its start mark on the table; the crane, ground patches and marks are fixed.
fidelity: A 1:20 model: the crane is fixed and its outriggers don't come down, so the pads are judged before the crane is set up. Ground capacity is given as a number, not simulated as soil, and pads are rigid. Full-size pad areas and loads are stated in the instruction.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0 (step limit reached, no pad on a landing mark); demo: 1.0
